test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

Shruti is a __strange person__ because of her attitude.
solution: The correct answer is: **Queer fish** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Queer fish**" is an idiom that means someone who is unusual or eccentric. (कोई व्यक्ति जो असामान्य या विलक्षण हो) • **Example**: *Ever since he started collecting antique teapots, people in the neighbourhood considered him a bit of a queer fish.* • The sentence is saying that Shruti's attitude makes her a strange person, which fits with the definition of "queer fish." Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**A one man**" is not an idiom and doesn't fit the sentence contextually. • "**A scarlet woman**" refers specifically to a woman who is seen as promiscuous or immoral. (एक महिला जिसे व्यभिचारी या अनैतिक माना जाता है) • "**A straw man**" refers to an argument or position that is set up to be easily defeated. (एक तर्क या स्थिति जो आसानी से पराजित होने के लिए बनाई गई हो) 3c:T600, The correct answer is: **D, A, C, E, B**
